notes: Modyo DXP pages (Rails, Bootstrap, jQuery) with Vue 2 widgets mounted after load; catalogue, prices and stock come from api.pcfactory.cl (public GET, CORS *).

Every navigation between page types is a full document load: category, product, search (/busqueda-avanzada?search=a+b), pagination (&page=N, 1-based), /carro, /checkout. Filters, sort, add to cart and cart quantity stay in the page (replaceState).
Category URL = /categoria + the menu's link; the bare link without /categoria redirects (302) to home. The same category id can sit under several parents (aliases).

Listing facets: the API's 'Sucursales' is written 'Tiendas' on the page, and an option the API leaves blank is written 'Otros'. The Tiendas list shows 'Internet' and the 28 stores (with a 'Santiago' group label among them). Category listings filter brands by id (marcas=299), search results by name (marcas=Acer).
There is no search autocomplete: typing fires no request; Enter or the magnifier loads /busqueda-avanzada.

Three prices on every card and product: 'Transferencia / Débito' (efectivo, the headline), 'Otros medios de pago' (normal, credit card) and the struck precio de referencia the -N% badge is computed against. The PDP JSON-LD offers.price is the 'Otros medios' price.
Product pages note 'Stock desfasado 20 minutos'. Stock reads 'N disponibles' / '+100 Unid.'.
The cart lives in localStorage.cartProducts; the delivery cost is never shown before checkout ('El valor del despacho se calculará cuando se seleccione el tipo de entrega').
Store zones disagree: /tiendas files the stores under Norte (5), Santiago (13) and Sur (10), with Viña del Mar in Norte; the stock API groups them Norte, Santiago, Centro and Sur.
Some store names differ between /tiendas and the stock API and listing filter (stores.json keeps both: name, stock_name).

A store's map card ('Ver tienda') shows the schedule of the store's group (Mall Plaza, calle, Cenco …) when it has one, which can differ from the store entry's own text (stores.json: hours = the card, entry_hours = the entry).
No cookie banner, no first-visit modal, no CSP. pcFactory's own assistance button (#pcfAssistanceWrapper: Ocular video advisors and TalkCenter chat) sits bottom-right.
